title: A schema whose input names a URN NO FILE DECLARES, in any state of this corpus.
$comment: THIS IS THE COST CASE, and the generator writes the cost down itself: while any file is unparseable, this genuinely-unresolvable URN is reported as `derived` rather than as the contract defect it is. That is the safe direction — it defers a contract finding until the corpus is readable rather than asserting one on an index that could not see half the answer. `nowheredeclared` appears in no `$id` anywhere; grep it if you doubt that, which is cheaper than trusting this sentence.
